company_name: Suzhou Origin Materials Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides essential high-purity chemical precursors and specialty materials for semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: Suzhou Origin Materials Technology Co., Ltd. develops and produces advanced materials crucial for semiconductor manufacturing. Their offerings include high-purity silicon-based materials, photoresists, and etching agents, supporting the fabrication of integrated circuits and semiconductor devices.
